anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Fourteenth, in the midst of the evenings.

pass_a_gloss: [gap] we have come out. Accordingly there are also other things showing that in the first month on the fourteenth of the month in the midst of the evenings the pascha has been legislated to be sacrificed, the light of the moon having become full and perfect.
pass_b_english: [lacuna] we have [come out]. And [accordingly] there are also [other things showing] that the Passover has been [legislated to be sacrificed] in [the first month on] the fourteenth of the month [in the midst of the] evenings, when the [light of the] moon has become full and perfect.
